description: NEC IR remote decoder: VS1838B output on PB12 (pull-up, EXTI12 both edges), TIM2 free-running at 1 MHz times every burst and space; prints 'NEC addr=0x.. cmd=0x..' and 'NEC repeat' on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. TIM2 PSC 71 (1 MHz), ARR 0xFFFF, running from boot. PB12 input with pull-up, EXTI12 on both edges, priority 0. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Boot: 'NEC IR receiver on PB12 (EXTI12 + TIM2 1 MHz)
'. Every edge is timestamped: a rising edge ends a burst (output low), a falling edge ends a space. A 9 ms burst (+-20 %) followed by a 4.5 ms space starts a frame, followed by a 2.25 ms space it is a repeat code ('NEC repeat
'); in a frame each 562.5 us burst (+-40 %) is followed by a 562.5 us (bit 0) or 1687.5 us (bit 1) space, LSB first; after 32 bits the main loop prints 'NEC addr=0x<aa> cmd=0x<cc>
' when bytes 2 and 4 are the inverses of 1 and 3, else 'NEC frame error <hex>
'; any other timing aborts. Silent without IR input.

circuit: USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
no IR receiver on PB12 (tests/devices/sensors-firmware.test.ts wires a VS1838B instead)

boot.USART1: NEC IR receiver on PB12 (EXTI12 + TIM2 1 MHz)
